runs.title: Add --export PATH to maintenance.py for the due-list
runs.report:
Added --export PATH to maintenance.py due-list. export_due() reuses atomic write_rows_atomic (temp file in dest dir + os.replace); main() rejects --export without --due (exit 2) and --json/--export are mutually exclusive. Selection unchanged via unfinished_due_by(), so in-progress chores are included alongside open ones. README gained a "Due-list CSV export" section. Tests: python3 -m pytest -q -> 36 passed, incl. export columns, in-progress inclusion, --export requires --due, invalid date/source leaves existing export byte-identical, header-only empty selection, comma quoting, no temp file left, json+export rejected. Live repro: python3 maintenance.py --due 2026-10-01 --export due-2026-10-01.csv -> "Wrote 2 unfinished chore(s)"; CSV contains title,due,status + Replace smoke alarm batteries,2026-09-20,open + Repaint front step,2026-09-25,in-progress; text and JSON modes still match. No scratch files left.
landed on acceptance/active: 4 files
